acolhimento.title: A relapse doesn't erase what you've built
acolhimento.text: Your rank and total XP stay with you. Only the streak resets. Before that, let's understand what happened — it takes less than a minute.

gatilho.title: What was going on?
gatilho.subtitle: Select what applies. You can pick more than one, or none.

sentia.title: What were you feeling before?
sentia.subtitle: No judgment. Just a note to help you spot the pattern yourself.
sentia.placeholder: E.g.: I was exhausted and alone after work

virada.title: What would you do differently?
virada.subtitle: This answer is what changes the next tough moment.

compromisso.title: Choose a concrete commitment
compromisso.subtitle: Just one small, achievable action — not the perfect plan.

escolhaPlaceholder: Write it in your own words

fechamento.title: This stays with you
fechamento.text: +15 XP for being honest with yourself. Your commitment is noted — the next choice is another opportunity.

sugestoesPadrao: Pause and observe what I felt before acting
Tell someone I trust when I notice the trigger
Have a concrete plan ready for the next tough moment
compromissosPadrao: Tell someone I trust what happened
Remove the app or site from reach for the next 24h
Plan something to do during my highest-risk time
Turn on focus or do-not-disturb mode today
Have a replacement activity ready for the next trigger
Set a fixed bedtime for tonight

Tédio: Have something ready to do during empty moments
Leave the house as soon as boredom starts
Write down 3 quick activities to turn to when it hits
Solidão: Plan to talk to someone before being alone too long
Call someone I trust as soon as loneliness shows up
Go somewhere with people, even without interacting much
Estresse: Release stress through movement before getting home
Have a 10-minute decompression ritual at the end of the day
Write about what's causing the stress
Ansiedade: Practice breathing before the anxiety turns into an urge
Tell someone when I notice anxiety rising
Take a physical break before any screen
Conflito / Briga: Step away from the situation for a few minutes before reacting
Write down what I feel instead of acting in the heat of the moment
Talk to someone neutral before deciding anything
Cansaço: Sleep earlier over the next few days
Actually rest instead of turning to a screen
Redes sociais: Set a screen time limit at night
Turn off notifications from the apps that trigger it most
Swap endless scrolling for another activity at that time
Álcool ou outras substâncias: Avoid being alone right after drinking
Have an agreed plan ready ahead of these situations
Call someone I trust before the effect wears off
Excesso de tempo livre: Plan the next hour around something concrete
Fill the emptiest slots of the week with commitments
Keep a list of small tasks for these moments
Notificações / celular: Turn on do-not-disturb during risk hours
Leave the phone out of the bedroom at night
Block or uninstall the app that triggers it most
